operations: full-text, UniProt, ligand component and sequence entry search
bioactivity records (IC50, Ki, Kd, EC50, GI50, Inhibition)

providers.license: public-domain (U.S. National Library of Medicine terms)
operations: study search by intervention, condition or term with phase and status filters

artifacts.payload: structure {sourceRef, contentSha256, format} + representation + colorTheme; optional agentlas.science-residue-interaction/v1
artifacts.files: agentlas-structures/<ID>/<ID>.cif|.pdb, <ID>.molstar.json, <ID>_assembly-1.jpeg (RCSB preview) beneath the run's working folder

limitations: Binding-site residues are a distance criterion on deposited coordinates (first model, altloc blank or A); they are not an interaction-energy or docking result.
Covalent bonds are reported as declared in the entry (struct_conn covale) and, separately, as heavy-atom pairs closer than 2.2 Å.
AlphaFold pLDDT is model confidence, not experimental evidence; ligand-bound conformations are not predicted.
ChEMBL values are reported as curated; units other than molar concentrations are not converted. Mutation filtering uses the variant field first and the assay description second, and says which.
ClinicalTrials.gov returns registry entries; efficacy endpoints come from posted results or publications.

The structure view uses the same artifact shape as Agentlas Science's source-to-molstar; inside Science a source version is minted by Science's own retrieval of the same entry, whose bytes carry the same content hash.
